metadata.title: Seattle Burke-Gilman existing mainline, grouped into eight approximate map areas
metadata.crs: WGS84 / EPSG:4326; GeoJSON coordinates are [longitude, latitude]
metadata.excluded: Ballard Missing Link gap; BURKE GILMAN ACCESS TRL and BURKE GILMAN SAND PT TRL branches; trail north of Seattle city limit. No lines were invented to close gaps.
metadata.areas: Eight approximate groups inherit the existing PDF map section ranges, not official neighborhood boundaries. Boundaries are projected onto the official centerline.

georeference.method: Affine fit initialized from three matching trail endpoints, then least-squares iterative closest-point refinement against all PDF trail vertices. Used only to locate approximate area boundaries on the official centerline.
